# SSAC27 full paper — E26, an identity audit of the 674 forecast arrivals

**Status: exploratory** (Amendment 6, `docs/research/sloan-full-paper-preregistration-amendment-6-2026-11-12.md`, commit `245bafa4b`). Generated by `scripts/sloan_fullpaper_arrivals_audit.py`; rendered by `scripts/report_sloan_fullpaper_arrivals_audit.py` from `docs/research/artifacts/sloan-fullpaper-arrivals-audit-2026-11/`. It is not a third look at the estimation pairs (E13, E25): the unit here is a forecast arrival.

## In plain words

Every headline number in the paper is scored on 674 arrivals. Each one joins a player's domestic season to his EuroLeague or EuroCup season a year later, by name. E26 checks every arrival by rules fixed in advance, with no hand decisions, and then re-scores the paper's three main comparisons without the arrivals classed wrong.

**Result.** 4 of the 674 arrivals (0.6%) are classed as identity mismatches. 578 (85.8%) are confirmed by independent evidence. 87 (12.9%) rest on the name across a change of club: the destination player is one identified person and no second player of that name is visible. 5 (0.7%) are unresolved.

**The three comparisons read the same without the arrivals classed wrong.** They also keep their readings on the two stricter subsets (table below). The WRONG share is below the 5% level at which the amendment calls it a data-quality finding.

## Specification

| Choice | This analysis | Alternative printed |
|---|---|---|
| **Unit** | one forecast arrival: player × destination season, his domestic source record (the season before) and his continental destination record | — |
| **Population** | the 674 v10 target keys, destination seasons 2020–2025, pool A; a census, nothing sampled or dropped | — |
| **Estimator** | E26a: the number and share of arrivals in each class. E26b: the three registered paired comparisons re-scored on class-defined subsets, forecasts as already fitted | the registered values on all arrivals |
| **Null** | E26a: none. E26b: zero difference for each paired comparison | — |
| **Filter** | v10 eligibility; subsets defined only by the E26a classes | S2 and S3 |
| **Key** | `player_name × season_dest` | — |
| **Uncertainty** | E26a: exact counts (a census). E26b: two-way clustered 95% intervals (player, destination club-season) | — |

## Gates

| Gate | Result | Negative control |
|---|---|---|
| G26a inputs: pairs, cohort, the registered results and the API list equal their sha256; the 674 keys join one-to-one | passed | a changed byte in the API list: rejected as required |
| G26b same forecasts: on all 674, the three comparisons reproduce the committed registered values | passed (largest gap 0.0e+00, tolerance 1e-09) | a shifted forecast: rejected as required |
| G26c same rules: the E13 sample re-audited through this generator reproduces the committed E13 results | passed (100 pairs) | a changed club threshold: rejected as required (90 classes change) |
| G26d the previous-team rule is not vacuous: its match share is at least 2 times the share after a seeded shuffle | passed: 445 of 674 (66.0%) against 2 (0.3%) after the shuffle | text controls passed (two Tel Aviv clubs must not match; Gravelines must match its long name) |
| Raw records reconcile with each arrival (game counts, both sides) | destination 674/674, source 674/674 | — |

**Order of events.** One retained run from a committed generator, `research-runs/sloan-fullpaper/arrivals-audit-01`: status `complete` (return code 0), generator sha256 `b4e684d0af955683…`, 535 input files. Inside the run the classes are computed and written first; the subsets are scored afterwards. Before that run, two things had been computed on the arrivals during development and are disclosed in the generator's commit message: the forecast gate G26b on already published numbers, and a count of raw game rows against the cohort.

## E26a. Classes

| Class | Arrivals | Share | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| CONFIRMED | 578 | 85.8% | independent evidence links the source record to the destination player |
| NAME ONLY | 87 | 12.9% | the destination player is one identified person, no second player of that name is visible; the link across his change of club rests on the name |
| WRONG | 4 | 0.6% | a registered contradiction |
| UNRESOLVED | 5 | 0.7% | no registered evidence either way |

| Evidence behind the CONFIRMED arrivals (an arrival can have several) | Arrivals |
|---|---|
| The API's previous team matches a source club | 442 |
| The two birthdates agree | 322 |
| Stayed at the source club, and the E13 check confirms that record | 140 |
| The same API person in continental play in the source season, confirmed by the E13 check | 76 |

142 arrivals stayed at a source club and 532 changed club. Both sides carry one birthdate for 325 arrivals (322 agree, 3 contradict). The API lists a previous team for 668 arrivals.

## E26b. Do the comparisons depend on the arrivals classed wrong?

Forecasts are the ones already fitted; nothing is refitted. Positive favours translation in the first and third columns and the league-aware forecast in the second. The margin is 2% of the league-aware forecast's error on the subset.

| Subset | n | Translation vs history | League-aware vs history + translation | Translation added to league-aware | Margin | Registered readings |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| All arrivals (registered values) | 674 | +0.161 [+0.077, +0.246] | +0.011 [−0.027, +0.049] | −0.002 [−0.028, +0.024] | 0.058 | all three hold |
| S1: without WRONG (primary) | 670 | +0.167 [+0.081, +0.252] | +0.009 [−0.029, +0.047] | −0.001 [−0.027, +0.025] | 0.058 | all three hold |
| S2: without WRONG and UNRESOLVED | 665 | +0.170 [+0.084, +0.255] | +0.009 [−0.029, +0.048] | +0.001 [−0.025, +0.027] | 0.059 | all three hold |
| S3: CONFIRMED only | 578 | +0.170 [+0.079, +0.261] | +0.005 [−0.038, +0.048] | +0.002 [−0.025, +0.028] | 0.059 | all three hold |

Registered readings: translation's gain over history has an interval above zero; the other two have intervals that include zero and lie inside the margin.

## Licences (Amendment 6, E26)

| Licence | Rule | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| E26a count | always stated | "By fixed rules, 4 of the 674 forecast arrivals are classed as identity mismatches; 578 are confirmed by independent evidence, 87 rest on the name across a change of club, and 5 are unresolved." |
| E26b, S1 | all three readings hold on S1 | **earned**: "the three comparisons read the same without the arrivals classed wrong" |
| E26b, S2 and S3 | printed as sensitivity checks; S3 is not a replacement estimate | printed above |
| Data-quality finding | WRONG share of 5% or more | 0.6%: not triggered |
| Previous-team evidence | used only if G26d passes | used |

## What this does not show

* **What the rules can detect.** A wrong join is detected when the two birthdates disagree or when a second player of the same name is visible in the records at the relevant time. A namesake who left the covered leagues is invisible. NAME ONLY marks that region.
* **No refit.** The models were fitted on training arrivals that are not audited here. E26b removes arrivals from scoring only.
* **Career history is not audited.** The history feature joins a player's earlier seasons by the same name key.
* **The previous-team rule is a text match.** It misses spelling and sponsor variants and can, rarely, match two clubs from one city. Every compared string is in `e26_arrivals.csv`.
* **S3 is not a typical sample of signings.** It keeps only arrivals with independent evidence.
